answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, cryptographic proof-of-stake functions as a core Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring nodes to lock capital to validate transactions and cast a verified network signal. Much like a rare gem such as an opal, identity value is artificially scarce and computationally expensive to manufacture. This economic friction ensures that an attacker cannot easily forge thousands of false identities without suffering catastrophic capital depletion, thereby securing consensus integrity.
